# IPlacedBomb.Explode method

Sets it off now, as its runner's detonator does, which also takes the detonator away. It does nothing once it exploded.

```csharp
public void Explode()
```

## Remarks

A detonation that reaches a game after its bomb went off there sets it off a second time, at the same place.
